name: DokuWiki
description: Simple wiki that keeps its pages as plain text files, no database needed

paths.name: Storage
paths.description: All your pages, uploads, settings, users and plugins, as plain files. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: DokuWiki pages and admin, published on host as 6783

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: PHP_TIMEZONE
variables.description: The time zone for dates on pages and in the history. It is filled in from your MOS time zone.

variables.name: PHP_UPLOADLIMIT
variables.description: The biggest file you can upload to the media manager, like 128M.
